The PID at this moment

No real car keeps up. With the most push, 3 m/s2, from the first instant and no drag, the AV would need \(8/3 = 2.7\) s to reach 8 m/s: that is the fastest any run could be. Ours are slower, because the engine lags 0.3 s and drag takes part of the push: at 2.7 s, all four runs are still at full allowed throttle and the AV is at 6.42 m/s. The target is a speed only, never a place; the gap is the speed error added up over time. The lecture's moment: PID + clamp at 3.0 s, the AV at 7.09 m/s, 13.9 m behind the ghost's 24 m.
